body.name: Blind row-scaled SVD
body.construction: Set \(Z^{\mathrm B}_{ij}=A_{ij}Y_{ij}/\widehat p_i-(1-A_{ij})Y_{ij}/(1-\widehat p_i)\), compute \(\widehat M^{\mathrm B}=\mathcal P_r(Z^{\mathrm B})\), and report its leading left singular matrix \(\widehat U^{\mathrm B}\).
inputs: Assignments and outcomes, discarding entrywise propensities.
